decision_reason: The first runnable shell was implemented and tested locally in jsgui3-server, then intentionally parked in two git stashes before the v0.0.156 release. It is recoverable but is not present in the current working tree, local branch history, or remote history.

owner_readiness.latest_recheck_summary: Current master is clean and does not contain the docs-viewer paths. stash@{0} contains all five implementation/test files; stash@{1} contains the tests/test-runner.js registration. Both stored patches pass git apply --check against current master.
owner_readiness.gate: The shell is recoverable, but not currently runnable from the checkout. Recover it on a dedicated owner branch by applying (not popping) both stashes, verify, and commit before marking it implemented in branch/remote history.

first_runnable_path.blocked_by: Implementation is stored only in local stash@{0}/stash@{1}; owner files are absent from the current checkout and all branch/remote history.

implementation_files.purpose: Starts the first bounded docs-viewer shell from jsgui3-server without changing existing examples.
Loads inventory data, registers explicit page routes, and registers source/inventory API handlers.
Renders the index and entry pages with live preview, source, command, owner, status, test, and failure slots.
Client bundle entry for future activation of the shell controls; first pass may be server-rendered only.
Owner-side route and rendering contract tests for the shell.

routes.response: HTML index page listing docs-viewer inventory entries.
HTML index page listing docs-viewer inventory entries.
HTML entry page for one manifest-backed example.
JSON copy of the checked docs-viewer inventory with no generated smoke output.
Plain-text docs, framework, component, or example source for one inventory source slot. kind must be docs, framework, component, or example.
JSON status summary with inventory status, entry count, deferred count, smoke status counts, registered routes, source kinds, and missing declared source or test refs.

runtime_data_loading.rule: Load JSON from JSGUI3_DOCS_VIEWER_INVENTORY when set; otherwise load ../jsgui3-ecosystem/docs/examples/docs_viewer_inventory.json relative to the jsgui3-server repo root.
Resolve source refs from each inventory ref repo_path and path; render a failure slot instead of hiding missing files.

assertions: GET /api/docs-viewer/inventory returns schema_version, entries, owner_repo, viewer_path, expected_result, live_preview, docs, source, related_tests, and last_smoke fields.
GET /docs/examples returns an HTML shell with docs, live preview, framework source, component source, example source, run command, owner repo, smoke status, related tests, and failure panel labels.
GET /docs/examples/:manifest_id renders the selected entry and does not start, mutate, or fork the owning example.
GET /api/docs-viewer/source?manifest_id=<id>&kind=docs&index=0 returns source text for an existing docs slot.
GET /api/docs-viewer/source?manifest_id=<id>&kind=framework&index=0 returns source text for an existing framework slot.
GET /api/docs-viewer/source?manifest_id=<id>&kind=component&index=0 returns source text for an existing component slot.
GET /api/docs-viewer/source?manifest_id=<id>&kind=example&index=0 returns source text for an existing example slot.
GET /api/docs-viewer/status returns entry counts, smoke status counts, routes, source kinds, and missing declared refs without launching examples.
Missing source files and unknown manifest ids return explicit 404 or failure-slot output.

non_goals: Do not launch sibling example servers from the shell in the first pass.
Do not make jsgui3-modern-examples startup part of default CI.
Do not add Webpage or Website live viewer pages until a served example exists.
Do not edit jsgui3-simple-example until its dirty worktree and stale smoke script are reconciled.
